places.name: Cardiff Castle
places.ai_summary: A historic castle and Victorian Gothic mansion located in the heart of Cardiff. It features Roman foundations, medieval walls, and lavish interiors.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 1 hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Climb the Norman Keep for panoramic views of the city.
places.address: Castle St, Cardiff CF10 3RB, United Kingdom

places.name: Principality Stadium
places.ai_summary: A world-class sports and entertainment venue, home to the Welsh national rugby team. The stadium features a retractable roof and hosts major events.

opening_hours.notes: Tour times vary; check website for availability.

places.place_tip: Book a stadium tour to explore behind the scenes, including the players' tunnel and locker rooms.
places.address: Westgate St, Cardiff CF10 1NS, United Kingdom

places.name: National Museum Cardiff
places.ai_summary: A cultural treasure trove featuring art, natural history, and geology exhibits. Highlights include Impressionist paintings and a fascinating dinosaur collection.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays except for bank holidays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Evolution of Wales gallery, which takes you on a journey through 4.6 billion years of history.
places.address: Cathays Park, Cardiff CF10 3NP, United Kingdom

places.name: Cardiff Bay
places.ai_summary: A vibrant waterfront area with shops, restaurants, and attractions. Enjoy scenic walks, boat trips, and the iconic Wales Millennium Centre.

opening_hours.notes: Some attractions and restaurants may have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Take a boat tour of the bay for a unique perspective of the city and its waterfront attractions.
places.address: Cardiff Bay, Cardiff CF10 4PZ, United Kingdom

places.ai_summary: An iconic arts centre known for its stunning architecture and diverse cultural events, including opera, ballet, and concerts.

places.place_tip: Explore the building's unique design and catch a show for an unforgettable cultural experience.

places.name: Roath Park
places.ai_summary: A picturesque park featuring a lake, gardens, and a lighthouse. Ideal for leisurely walks, picnics, and enjoying nature.

opening_hours.notes: Gardens and conservatory have specific opening times.

places.place_tip: Visit the Roath Park Conservatory to see a variety of plants and flowers in a beautiful setting.

places.name: Bute Park
places.ai_summary: A large urban park located near the city centre, featuring gardens, woodlands, and the River Taff. Great for walking, cycling, and relaxation.

opening_hours.notes: Some facilities may have specific opening times.

places.place_tip: Explore the park's many trails and don't miss the beautiful arboretum.

places.name: St Fagans National Museum of History
places.ai_summary: An open-air museum chronicling the historical lifestyle, culture, and architecture of the Welsh people. It features original buildings and exhibits.
places.name_english: St Fagans National Museum of History

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 16:00. Closed on December 25th and January 1st.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking around the extensive grounds.

places.name: Llandaff Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A stunning medieval cathedral known for its impressive architecture, beautiful stained glass, and serene gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Check for service times and special events.

places.place_tip: Take time to explore the surrounding gardens and the nearby Llandaff village.
places.address: The Cathedral Close, Cardiff CF5 2LA, United Kingdom

places.name: Penarth Pier
places.ai_summary: A beautiful Victorian pier offering stunning views of the Bristol Channel. It's a great spot for a leisurely stroll and enjoying the seaside atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: The pier is open all year round, but some facilities may be seasonal.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby beach and enjoy some fish and chips from a local vendor.
places.address: Penarth Pier, Penarth CF64 3AU, United Kingdom

places.name: Castell Coch
places.ai_summary: A fairy-tale castle nestled in the woods, known for its stunning architecture and beautiful interior rooms.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 30 minutes before closing. Closed on December 24th, 25th, and 26th.

places.place_tip: Explore the beautiful grounds and enjoy the views from the castle terrace.

places.name: Techniquest
places.ai_summary: An interactive science and discovery centre, great for families. It features hands-on exhibits, a planetarium, and science shows.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission 1 hour before closing. Closed on December 25th and January 1st.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for live science demonstrations and planetarium shows.

places.name: Mermaid Quay
places.ai_summary: A popular waterfront destination with a variety of restaurants, bars, and shops. Enjoy dining with a view of the water.

opening_hours.notes: Individual restaurant hours may vary.

places.place_tip: Try to get a table at a restaurant with a view of the water for a memorable dining experience.

places.ai_summary: A cultural venue and former church, now an arts centre. It hosts exhibitions, concerts, and community events.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedule for event times and possible admission fees.

places.place_tip: Explore the exhibitions and enjoy a coffee at the café with a view of the waterfront.

opening_hours.notes: Individual shop hours may vary. Closed on bank holidays.

places.place_tip: Look out for unique gifts and enjoy a coffee in one of the charming cafes.

places.place_tip: Try some local delicacies and explore the variety of goods on offer.

opening_hours.notes: Check for public tour availability and times.

places.place_tip: Take a stroll around the waterfront and enjoy the views of the building and the bay.

places.name: Gorsedd Gardens
places.ai_summary: A public park featuring beautiful gardens, sculptures, and the iconic Welsh Dragon. It's a peaceful spot in the city centre.

opening_hours.notes: Some features may be closed at night.

places.best_time_to_visit: Anytime, but best in spring and summer
places.place_tip: Visit the nearby National Museum Cardiff for a full day of culture and history.

places.name: Museum of Cardiff
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the history and culture of Cardiff, featuring interactive exhibits and collections.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and Tuesdays. Check for holiday hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the interactive exhibits and don't miss the Cardiff Story gallery.
places.address: Cardiff CF10 3NP, United Kingdom

places.name: Taff Trail
places.ai_summary: A scenic trail following the River Taff, ideal for walking and cycling. It passes through beautiful landscapes and parks.

opening_hours.notes: Some sections may be closed in winter; check local advice.

places.best_time_to_visit: Anytime, but spring and summer are best
places.place_tip: Start at the northern end in Brecon Beacons for a more challenging walk or cycle.
